minutes.headline: Water commissioners reviewed failed Article 25 and the Hickory Hills pilot test; financing was passed over.
minutes.summary: The commissioners discussed Town Meeting's Warrant Article 25 and said they want to be notified of changes touching the Zone 1-3 water protections. They heard that the Hickory Hills pilot test is finished with results pending, and discussed SRF principal forgiveness and a stalled contract change order on the water main project. Minutes were approved by voice vote and the meeting ended with a motion to adjourn.
